name: NBU Data Ukraine: National Bank of Ukraine key policy rate (облікова ставка) on a date,
description: National Bank of Ukraine key policy rate (облікова ставка) on a date, with the overnight deposit and overnight loan rates and every policy-rate change in the previous ~13 months. Call it for Ukrainian loan or deposit maths, late-payment penalties tied to the NBU rate, macro briefs, or to see when the rate last moved. Param: date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today in Kyiv).
